images.alt: A flock of paper swallows follows one satin ribbon across a daybreak sky.
images.source: Editorial illustration on a soft Daylight sky at daybreak. A large flock of small faceted paper swallows, several dozen of them, flies in a loose but orderly formation from the lower left toward the upper right. Every bird follows the same long satin ribbon that arcs across the frame in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan, so the whole flock reads as one capable team moving together. The birds are folded from flat paper planes in Partner Navy, slate blue and pale cyan, each catching the light on its upper-left facets. A low band of flat faceted paper hills in pale blue-grey runs along the bottom edge. Keep the upper left quarter calm and empty. Near-square, about 1:1, safe to crop to 4:5. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.

notes: Skill leads, price follows (Brand DNA: lead with skill, then price). The Philippines base is said in copy only; no regional motifs in any image. Header marks About as current. One Primary in the hero and one in the closing band. Every number on the page carries a Source key and a dated source line in its own section; FAQ answers avoid numbers so they need none. Every promise is Brand DNA wording (values, Questions buyers will ask, Why we cost less); nothing else is promised. Review 2026-11-03: the Privacy title says personal data (what the Data Privacy Act covers), not all of a partner’s data; the Quality and Costs leads no longer repeat their titles and cards; the Quality icons now match their cards.
